Fetching data

The client talks to a remote endpoint over HTTP and turns the response into a typed object. Requests are retried with backoff, so a transient failure does not surface to the caller, and every response is validated before it reaches application code. This paragraph exists to give the article extractor enough prose to score the page as an article rather than as chrome.

Reading the quickstart guide first is recommended, because the transport layer is configured through environment variables rather than code.

Minimal example

The example below issues one request and prints the parsed body.

const res = await client.request(url);
console.log(res.status);

Images are kept only when they carry alternative text; tracking pixels and one-pixel spacers are dropped entirely because they add tokens without adding meaning.
